phrases.phrase: Enlistment applications waiting for a clerk to pick up
{title} has been sitting in the enlistment queue past the deadline with no clerk on it. Please pick it up.
Thanks for enlisting with the 7th Cavalry. Your application is still in the queue, and a member of the processing team will review it soon. You don't need to do anything for now.
Scan the enlistment queue for un-actioned applications
The XenForo user ID the reminder note is posted as. Default: 598.

Roster position IDs whose seated members count as processing clerks. A reply from anyone holding one of these positions, as a primary or a secondary seat, counts as the application being picked up, so it is not reminded. Enter one ID per line or separate with commas. Default: 579, 580, 751, 960, 1012.

How many hours an application may sit in the queue with no clerk reply before it is reminded. The minimum is 1 hour; 0 or lower falls back to the default of 24 so the reminder cannot fire on the whole queue at once.

The forum node whose open applications the reminder scans (the Enlistment Papers queue). Only threads directly in this node are checked; the Completed and Denied child forums are left alone. Default: 325.
Reminds the processing team about enlistment applications that have sat in the queue past the deadline with no clerk reply.
